premises: Fixed R no plugin/reopen/concurrent scene mutation.
Scene preparation normal, two valid pictures and ordinary Graphics/Input/pbUpdate operations return.
The described decisive iteration has advanced both PictureEx tracks so both running? would be false after the updates.
cancancel is the boolean argument; the ordinary scenario uses cancancel=true; separate control sets false.
BACK trigger occurs at the Input query in this same iteration; no claim about physical key mapping or host scheduling.

跳出后先FlashInOut，再取消统计/消息或Success。
Flash及成功段不再处理该动画BACK取消。

normal_control.input: cancancel=true; no BACK trigger in final update
normal_control.ordered_result: picture1.update/apply→picture2.update/apply→Graphics.update→Input.update→pbUpdate(true)→BACK condition false→running? both false→break→pbFlashInOut(false)→pbEvolutionSuccess. Successful messages and action_after_evolution precede species mutation, which is not moved into the animation loop.

last_iteration_back.input: same final iteration; cancancel=true; BACK trigger true
last_iteration_back.ordered_result: same two picture updates and input/update prefix→BACK condition true→pbBGMStop→pbPlayCancelSE→canceled=true→break before running? check→pbFlashInOut(true)→evolutions_cancelled+=1→stopped evolving message; no pbEvolutionSuccess/species mutation/evolution_count from this branch.

noncancelable_control.input: same final iteration with BACK true but cancancel=false
noncancelable_control.ordered_result: BACK&&cancancel false→running? check→normal success chain; BACK does not cancel. Trade cleanup and stone callers pass false under their separate contracts.

failure_prefix: If a Picture/Graphics/Input/pbUpdate operation raises before the BACK branch, this method gives no guarantee of reaching cancellation or success.
If pbBGMStop or cancel sound fails inside the BACK branch, preceding picture/input work remains; canceled assignment is later and is not invented as committed.
If pbFlashInOut or stopped-message fails after the break, completed cancellation prefix and any increment already reached remain; no local rescue/ensure guarantees external cleanup or process exit.

Success means a separate ordered method call. It increments evolution_count then waits cry/plays success message; only after the message and action_after_evolution does it assign species and derived state. No animation-complete condition proves later domain completion.
limits: No exact physical frame count, media existence, visible pixel or audio guarantee.
This interface does not approve all PictureEx consumers, all WP16 or all lifecycle.
